# Historical v1 compatibility corpus (B00)

Base source: `e709ed90e0890a619b91fdc2fe395439b20ffb65` on `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, Rust/Cargo 1.97.1, glibc 2.39, g++ 13.3.0, clang++ 18.1.3, Python 3.12.3. The precise source list, versions, hashes, counts, release asset hashes, S3 bundle manifest hashes, custody read paths and host identity are in `source-manifest.json`. Its `custody:B00/` read paths resolve under the external B00 evidence root named in the operator receipt; source URIs identify the immutable upstreams. `manifest.json` pins its SHA-256 and the content-addressed golden object under `crates/feat-math/fixtures/compat_freeze/historical_v1/objects/sha256/`.

The golden object covers 53 wire descriptors: 42 live witnesses from the existing `compat_freeze` fitted-model fixture, four separately fitted compatibility aliases, and seven quarantined kernel refusals. The existing `compat_freeze` test executes and bit-checks all 42 witnesses; this test pins their program bytes and bit records. All 19 Func and eight Var exact tags are encoded, decoded and evaluated across signed zeros, a NaN payload, infinities, subnormals, 1e-300, 1e200 and 1e308. A representative v1 program stores full emitted Rust, Python, C++17 recipe, JavaScript and fitted C++17 source/codec bytes with SHA-256s. The existing emitter fixture pins the full 55-program language success/refusal matrix. Five synthetic stored model JSON strings are retained exactly. Version and unknown-tag corruption must refuse before evaluation.

The old fitted C++ revision-2 source and a generated synthetic container are checked by `advanced_v3::fitted_cpp_runtime::tests::stored_revision_two_container_validates_and_load_regenerates_it`; the source hash is in `source-manifest.json`. No shipped feat-math fitted `Model`/`BoundModel` or revision-2 container was found in the inspected immutable release/tag/S3 sources. That shipped fitted-family compatibility claim is **held**. The three S3 bundles are neural `jope.model-bundle/v2` safetensors; their 21 weight blobs remain in custody at the S3 paths in `source-manifest.json` and are outside the feat-math fitted loader's format.

There is no regeneration mode or writer in the committed golden test. Run `cargo nextest run --locked -P pr -p feat-math --test historical_v1 --test compat_freeze`; both binaries must execute nonzero cases. `deploy/ci/emitters.sh` additionally runs the historical test and checks its count before compiling emitted programs. A future change to an old byte or bit is a failed compatibility gate, not a routine fixture update.
